definition.name: Published Polly default retry and timer factories

steps.name: Install the verified wasm-tools release asset
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
archive="$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-wasm-tools.tar.gz"
bindir="$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-wasm-tools-bin"
mkdir "$bindir"
timeout 90s gh api -H 'Accept: application/octet-stream' repos/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/releases/assets/483720667 | head -c 5862465 > "$archive"
unset GH_TOKEN
test "$(stat --format=%s "$archive")" = 5862464
printf '%s  %s\n' d0efb16c9c859137b7ab3e99151c299cd47caee106ed4594561002f7a04945bd "$archive" | sha256sum --check --strict
tar -xOzf "$archive" wasm-tools-1.254.0-x86_64-linux/wasm-tools > "$bindir/wasm-tools"
test "$(stat --format=%s "$bindir/wasm-tools")" = 20231696
printf '%s  %s\n' cc1f862d69363aac2d4a88f01c414a2dcf10858632d0c0a45e93ff60503979d6 "$bindir/wasm-tools" | sha256sum --check --strict
chmod 755 "$bindir/wasm-tools"
test "$("$bindir/wasm-tools" --version)" = 'wasm-tools 1.254.0 (bb58fdf91 2026-07-20)'
printf '%s\n' "$bindir" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

steps.name: Download this run's exact normal public products
Check captured graph, authority, original budgets and retirement controls
steps.run:
python3 -m pip install --requirement tools/requirements.lock
python3 -B -m unittest tools.tests.test_dotnet_published_tasks -v

steps.name: Install captured NativeAOT namespace and loader inputs
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install --yes bubblewrap libgdbm6t64 libreadline8t64 libsqlite3-0 liblttng-ust1t64 libtcl8.6 libtk8.6
sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0

steps.name: Install the pinned native compiler and closed runtime
steps.run:
set -o pipefail
timeout 180s gh api -H 'Accept: application/octet-stream' repos/WebAssembly/wasi-sdk/releases/assets/316597213 | head -c 119441679 > "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk.tar.gz"
unset GH_TOKEN
test "$(stat --format=%s "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk.tar.gz")" = 119441678
printf '%s  %s\n' 87d1d1a2879d139cdc624b968efad3d4a97b8078cdff95e63ac88ecafd1a0171 "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --strict
tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk.tar.gz" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP"
python3 tools/install_guest_bindgen.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-authoring-bindgen"
export PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-authoring-bindgen:$PATH"
printf '%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-authoring-bindgen" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
python3 tools/dotnet_capsule.py install-tools "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-authoring-tools" \
  --wasi-sdk "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk-29.0-x86_64-linux"

steps.name: Build fresh NativeAOT component and execute unchanged published task factories
Retain bounded published task observations including failures

with.name: dotnet-published-tasks-${{ github.sha }}
with.path:
${{ runner.temp }}/dotnet-published-tasks/qualified.json
${{ runner.temp }}/dotnet-published-tasks/FAILED.json
${{ runner.temp }}/dotnet-published-tasks/outside/evidence/**
${{ runner.temp }}/dotnet-published-tasks/logs/**
${{ runner.temp }}/dotnet-published-tasks/build/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/dotnet-published-tasks/build/component.wasm
${{ runner.temp }}/dotnet-published-tasks/build/logs/**
${{ runner.temp }}/dotnet-published-tasks/node/public-workflow.json
${{ runner.temp }}/dotnet-published-tasks/node/workflow.json
${{ runner.temp }}/dotnet-published-tasks/node/FAILED.json
${{ runner.temp }}/dotnet-published-tasks/node/controls/unexpected-invocation-diagnostics.json
${{ runner.temp }}/dotnet-authoring-tools/logs/*.stdout.txt
${{ runner.temp }}/dotnet-authoring-tools/logs/*.stderr.txt
${{ runner.temp }}/dotnet-authoring-tools/INSTALL-COMPLETE.json

reviewReason: Retain only existing bounded public installer stdout/stderr at all three existing unconditional upload sites; restore original definition exactly after removing two added paths. No compiler/recipe/limit/guard change. Use the existing verified main-job wasm-tools and WASI SDK release assets in this job after the ordinary runtime and filesystem owners hit HTTP 504; preserve all other commands, limits and conditions.
